domain: The copy for a walking-gear shop's search ads. data/ads.json holds each ad with how often it was shown (impressions) and clicked. brand.md says how we write ads. There is no code to change here: the work is the words.

steps.name: pick
steps.prompt: Work out each ad's click-through rate (clicks divided by impressions) from data/ads.json, and write the ids of the four lowest, as a JSON array, to data/underperformers.json. Change nothing else.

steps.name: rewrite
steps.prompt: Rewrite the headline and description of each ad listed in data/underperformers.json, following brand.md. Look at what the best-performing ads do and do the same. Leave every other ad, and every figure, exactly as it is.
